answer: Embodied Uptime Attestation. Each identity must periodically submit a hardware-signed heartbeat from a fixed physical wharf sensor it claims, and the sensor passes a random garden-side challenge proving continuous local presence. Identities sharing one physical site collapse because the sensor timestamps overlap, and each false heartbeat burns an ember of its daily nonce budget. An attacker must physically acquire and wire separate sensors per identity, paying hardware, installation, and maintenance costs per sybil.
